recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-core. Future InventoryItem wording changes should be made in HL7/oo-incubator; future product search-parameter harmonization should be handled by resource-specific Jira issues against active core resources.
issue_request: FHIR-35874 asked to advance the Product pattern for product delivery, tracking, and catalogs, including common search parameters, GS1 alignment, and consideration of a generic Product resource or common characteristic/relationship model across specialized product resources. OO resolved it as Applied/Not Persuasive with Modification: use InventoryItem for inventory/catalog capabilities, keep specialized product resources, rely on harmonized search parameters, and clarify when InventoryItem can stand alone versus reference specialized product resources.
initial_application: OO WGM minutes record the 12-0-0 FHIR-35874 motion and state that InventoryItem had been created, product-resource search parameters had been harmonized, and InventoryItem boundary wording should be added. The explicit FHIR-35874 source commit found was f73c212746740cc7e8a5dac6d8334c7f1a5d934f, merged through HL7/fhir#3122, which updated source/inventoryitem/inventoryitem-introduction.xml with the requested clarification. No separate FHIR-35874-tagged search-parameter commit was found; current product pattern and product-resource search parameter sources already contain the relevant surfaces.
additional_context: The current core build still includes the Product pattern and specialized product resources such as Medication, MedicationKnowledge, Device, DeviceDefinition, NutritionProduct, and BiologicallyDerivedProduct. Later governance moved InventoryItem and related low-maturity OO resources out of active core: commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed InventoryItem from source/fhir.ini and redirected the Administration module link to the OO Incubator page. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-39161 external-repo audit documenting that InventoryItem ownership moved out of current FHIR-core.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active core product pattern and specialized product-resource search parameter bundles are already present, and InventoryItem-specific edits would be out of current core build scope. Restoring or editing InventoryItem in FHIR-core would reverse later governance rather than complete FHIR-35874.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-39161 created InventoryItem as the generic inventory/catalog product resource and is already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit after InventoryItem moved to OO Incubator.
